negative_snippets: Do not book this property, it is fake. It is actually the Hotel Diamond Inn 1.2 km away. The photos on Agoda/Google do not match the actual hotel — the front desk admitted they use photos from a different property — and the listed location is inaccurate. While it is a budget hotel, it is not what is advertised and feels very misleading. Reviews I believe are mostly fake. They also attempted to charge me for breakfast despite my Agoda confirmation clearly including it. I have reported this listing to Agoda and Google due to the misrepresentation and to have the listing removed.

This hotel doesn't exist.  I sent a message when I showed up here with my bags, only to have them tell me it was a hotel a half mile away.  So, after arriving there, it's completely different from the photos.  The check-in process was chaotic.  I saw at least 5 cockroaches crawling through my room.  Oh, and the water coming from the faucets in the restroom definitely smelled like raw sewage, which was a first on my India adventure.  Would not recommend and do not believe the sparkling reviews, yikes.

I have been travelling full time for the last 5 months and frequently for the past 12 years and this place is the dirtiest i’ve ever seen. Hotel is absolutely disgusting.

Right when we entered our room, the bathroom and toilet seat were soaking wet and there was a wet tissue sitting on the sink counter. Door handle in the bathroom was broken off. Towels had brown stains all over it and the sheets clearly had not been washed. They smelled of body odour and had stains all over. When we asked for new bedding they brought another comforter with even more stains. They also were unable to bring us new pillowcases because their laundry was closed? We called the reception again and they told us we called the “wrong number” and hung up. Rooms also have 0 soundproofing, the room next to us was blasting music and screaming all night. After they quieted down, I could even hear them cracking their fingers.

We also did laundry service with the hotel, the clothes came back unwashed but ironed and folded. Stains were exactly the same as when we gave them the clothes, looked like they hadn’t even put water on it.

I already had lower expectations going into this booking because of the price but nothing could’ve prepared me for how unclean our room was. I have stayed in hostel bunk beds nicer than this. I could go on but please do yourself a favour and find somewhere else to stay.
